kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أنفصم (form VII)
# أَنْفَصِمُ (ʔanfaṣimu) /ʔan.fa.sˤi.mu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْفَصَمَ (infaṣama)
# أَنْفَصِمَ (ʔanfaṣima) /ʔan.fa.sˤi.ma/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْفَصَمَ (infaṣama)
# أَنْفَصِمْ (ʔanfaṣim) /ʔan.fa.sˤim/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِنْفَصَمَ (infaṣama)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
